title: A surprising thing is happening underneath the S&P 500's record run
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数创纪录的走势背后正在发生一件令人惊讶的事情
summary: Don't overlook the warning signs in the market.
summary_zh: 不要忽视市场上的警告信号。

title: Wall St futures subdued as U.S.-Iran talks stall
title_zh: 由于美伊谈判陷入僵局，华尔街期货下跌
summary: By Ragini Mathur and Utkarsh Hathi May 11 (Reuters) - Wall Street futures were subdued on Monday, taking a breather after a record rally last week, as investors fretted over signs of stalled talks
summary_zh: 作者：拉吉尼·马图尔 (Ragini Mathur) 和乌特卡什·哈蒂 (Utkarsh Hathi) 5 月 11 日（路透社）——华尔街期货周一低迷，在上周创纪录的上涨后稍作喘息，投资者对谈判陷入僵局的迹象感到担忧

title: Alphabet considers first yen bond sale to fund AI goals
title_zh: Alphabet 考虑首次发行日元债券来资助人工智能目标
summary: Alphabet plans to sell Japanese yen-denominated bonds for the first time, it disclosed in a filing on Monday, as technology giants ‌tap debt markets to fund artificial intelligence infrastructure deployments.
summary_zh: Alphabet 在周一提交的文件中披露，该公司计划首次出售以日元计价的债券，因为科技巨头正在利用债务市场为人工智能基础设施部署提供资金。

title: Tech stocks today: AI chipmaker Cerebras to stage blockbuster IPO, Nvidia's Jensen Huang goes to China
title_zh: 今日科技股：人工智能芯片制造商 Cerebras 将进行重磅 IPO，英伟达 (Nvidia) 的黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 前往中国
summary: The tech sector helped US stocks cruise to all-time highs last week, as the artificial intelligence boom broadened.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能热潮的扩大，科技板块帮助美国股市上周升至历史新高。

title: Amazon Prepares to Issue Its First Swiss Franc Bond in AI Push
title_zh: 亚马逊准备发行首支瑞士法郎债券以推动人工智能发展

title_zh: 消息人士称，安巴尼的 Jio 平台 IPO 转向纯粹融资，没有投资者退出

summary_zh: 作者：Aditya Kalra 和 Vibhuti Sharma 孟买，5 月 11 日（路透社）——穆克什·安巴尼 (Mukesh Ambani) 的 Reliance Jio 平台已转向纯粹为其计划的孟买上市筹集资金，出售了该公司 2.5% 的股份

title: Alphabet Plans Debut Yen Bond Sale as AI Race Accelerates
title_zh: 随着人工智能竞赛的加速，Alphabet 计划首次发售日元债券

title: AI Wins Have Alphabet Poised to Become World’s Biggest Company
title_zh: 人工智能的胜利让 Alphabet 有望成为世界上最大的公司
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Over the past year, Alphabet Inc. has gone from an artificial intelligence afterthought to the one firm in the market with dominant positions in nearly every aspect of the technology. Now it’s on the brink of overtaking AI chip giant Nvidia Corp.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在过去的一年里，Alphabet 公司已经从人工智能的后起之秀变成了市场上几乎在该技术的各个方面都占据主导地位的公司。现在它正处于超越人工智能芯片巨头英伟达公司的边缘。

title: Trump goes to China, inflation comes to America: What to watch this week
title_zh: 特朗普访问中国，通胀来到美国：本周看点
summary: Trump's China trip and the April inflation report will be the week's two biggest developments for investors.
summary_zh: 特朗普的中国之行和四月份的通胀报告将是投资者本周最关注的两个事态发展。
